results.title: Open Gambia - A Worrisome Silence From The IEC! While...
results.content: While most people no doubt welcome the recent press release from the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) requiring all registered political parties to hold their biennial congresses, there are certainly much more urgent things that the people expect the IEC to deal with before the next electoral cycle. It is quite a well-known fact that these party congresses are mere rituals which serve a minimal purpose apart from giving a chance to the parties' leadership to renew their positions and those of their cronies. It has been almost a year since the last presidential elections, and there are so many things that the IEC needs to do to prepare for the next electoral cycle. While in the case of the paper ballot, each polling booth would have only one ballot box for all the 20 candidates, and it would be placed in the open where everyone would see it.
